summary: Iteration 10 OR-Tools TSP fix verified — 9/9 pytest PASS in 25.88s. Card computes idx as (activeIdx if active && pendente) else first-pending (line 747-750). critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1249-1268 OR-Tools branch fires when len(pending)>=3 with use_google_matrix=False (Haversine × 1.3). Sets used_solver='ortools_haversine' — matches expected log token 'via ortools_haversine'.

server.py:1271-1284 Google Directions optimize branch is now gated by 'not optimized and len(pending) <= 25' — so ≤25 stops that fail OR-Tools can still recover via Google, but ≥26 skip Google entirely (which was the root cause of 177km routes: Google's optimize:true only handles 25 waypoints, remainder was tail-appended).
server.py:1287-1303 Nearest-neighbor is now a last-resort fallback only when both OR-Tools and Google fail — good defensive layering.
server.py:1323 final = done + optimized preserves the done-first invariant across all solver branches — Bug Fix #5 verified.
server.py:1229-1230 early return for len(pending)==0 correctly avoids metrics computation — Bug Fix #4 spec-compliant.

ortools_optimizer.py:174-283 optimize_with_ortools() uses PATH_CHEAPEST_ARC + GUIDED_LOCAL_SEARCH with 8s time limit — matches spec. Open-TSP via virtual node (line 135) for return_to_start=false. fixed_first / fixed_last hooks reserved for Reotimizar flow.
ortools_optimizer.py:60-117 _build_google_distance_matrix() batches 25×25 sub-matrices for Routes API v2 — solid for future use_google_matrix=True switch when quota allows.

route.tsx:743-822 floating stop card is a self-contained IIFE {(() => {...})()} — encapsulates idx computation, openMaps handler, and 3-action row cleanly. pointerEvents='box-none' on outer View lets map interactions pass through empty areas — nice touch.
route.tsx:825-830 restore-stop-card pill is gated by (stopCardHidden && pendingCount > 0) — correctly hides itself when everything is delivered so user isn't offered a card that has nothing to show.

route.tsx:798-812 fail/deliver TouchableOpacities call setActiveIdx(idx) THEN setTimeout(markStop, 0) — this defers the state read inside markStop() until the activeIdx state has committed. Correct pattern for React batching.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral only — 87-stop optimize payload uses random.seed(1234) for reproducibility; no DB writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10.py — 9 tests: 5 optimize bug fixes (87 / 5 / 2 / 0 / mixed stops), 3 regressions (geocode-batch, parse-text, auth-me / parse-file). Backend log signature to grep for future OR-Tools regressions: 'optimize: N stops via ortools_haversine → K km' in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log. Frontend Playwright UI tests for the floating stop card (tap X → restore pill → tap restore → card returns) require an authenticated route with pending stops. Static verification of testIDs and handlers was thorough. To unlock UI-level flow tests in the future, main agent should add a dev-mode localStorage seed for rota:token + rota:stops.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all 12 checklist items verified. Pre-fix RCA (documented by main agent): Google Directions API 'waypoints=optimize:true' only accepts ≤25 waypoints. For >25 stops, server.py used to append tail-first (nearest-neighbor-ish) which produced ~177km routes for 87 SP stops. Fix inserts OR-Tools solver (PATH_CHEAPEST_ARC + GUIDED_LOCAL_SEARCH) before the Google branch and unconditionally handles ≥3 stops, dropping the 87-stop route to ~60 km.
